pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(Ice cream)
(Ice cream)
(Ooh)
(Drip, drip)

[Hook]
[Duet Vocal]
Ice cream, Ice cream
Meltin' on my heart
Ice cream, Ice cream
Don't tear me apart

Ice cream, Ice cream
Sweet but bittersweet
네가 녹아내릴수록
더 선명해지는 memory

[Verse 1]
[Duet Vocal]
한여름 sunlight 아래
You're melting in my hand
종이컵에 담긴 promise
So cold, so sweet, so young

한입 베어 문 그 순간
We didn't know a thing
웃음이 drip drip 번지듯
Time just slipped away

[Pre-Chorus]
[Duet Vocal]
손끝에 남은 sweet stain
조금씩 번져가
Hold you tighter
더 미끄러져 가

You're inside my heart
조금씩 스며들어
Even goodbye
천천히 배워가

[Chorus]
[Duet Vocal]
Ice cream, Ice cream
녹아내려 you
Ice cream, Ice cream
내 맘 위로 ooh

Drip drip 떨어져도
I still love you
Love melts down
But leaves me whole

Ice cream, Ice cream
Like a dream
Summer love
Living in me

[Verse 2]
[Duet Vocal]
아직도 your name
입술 끝에 맴돌아
텅 빈 silver spoon 하나
Looks so lonely now

I'm saying "I'm okay"
속은 또 울컥해
예쁘게만 남을 수 없는
Some seasons fade

Will you come back?
아닌 걸 알아도
한참을 서성이다
I'm melting too

[Pre-Chorus]
[Duet Vocal]
손바닥 위를
흐르는 temperature
The more I hold
더 멀어지는 love

Letting you go
조금씩 배우며
Broken hearts can
Shine again

[Chorus]
[Duet Vocal]
Ice cream, Ice cream
녹아내려 you
Ice cream, Ice cream
내 맘 위로 ooh

Drip drip 떨어져도
I still love you
Love melts down
But leaves me whole

Ice cream, Ice cream
Like a dream
Summer love
Living in me

[Bridge]
[Duet Vocal]
다 녹아버린 뒤에
난 이제 알았어
우리의 sparkling days
Never disappear

차갑던 내 두 손도
Feels alive again
아픈 만큼 선명했던
My summer remains

(Hey)
Ice cream, Ice cream
Still so sweet
Even if you're gone
You're with me

[Final Chorus]
[Duet Vocal]
Ice cream, Ice cream
녹아내려 you
Ice cream, Ice cream
이 계절 위로

Drip drip 흘러도
I'll be alright
Love melts down
But leaves the light

Ice cream, Ice cream
Sweet goodbye
다 녹아도
You're my summertime

[Outro]
Ice cream...
Ice cream...
Melt away...
See you next summer...
